Day 27 21:36 feedback showed bed_b1, contradicting my guess of bedroom_floor_b1. It is not on the bedroom floor in the morning or late night. Check kitchen_table_k1 for early morning; bed_b1 for late night.

book_felix: Inconsistent. Day 27 21:33 feedback showed bed_b1, contradicting my guess of couch_l1. It is not on the couch in the evening. Check bed_b1 for late night; coffee_table_l1 for mid-day and afternoon.

glass_felix: Unpredictable. Day 27 22:59 feedback showed cupboard_k1, contradicting my guess of nightstand_b1. It is not on the nightstand in the late night. Check cupboard_k1 for late night; kitchen_table_k1 for early evening.

water_bottle_felix: Inconsistent. Moves between living and kitchen table. Day 22 19:12 feedback confirmed kitchen_table_k1. Check kitchen_table_k1 for late evening; coffee_table_l1 for early morning.

razor_felix: Inconsistent. Moves between shelf, cabinet, and sink. Day 25 07:11 and Day 26 07:00 feedback showed bathroom_shelf_ba1, contradicting my guesses of medicine_cabinet_ba1 and sink_ba_ba1. It is not in the cabinet or sink in the morning. Check bathroom_shelf_ba1 first in the morning.
